import cv2
import numpy as np
import math

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0084.png')
# Pose at frame 84
# 83 was (1.619, 2.957, 15.0 deg), moved 0.5m along 15.0 deg:
# dx = 0.5 * sin(15 deg) = 0.5 * 0.2588 = 0.129
# dy = 0.5 * cos(15 deg) = 0.5 * 0.9659 = 0.483
cam_x = 1.619 + 0.5 * math.sin(math.radians(15))
cam_y = 2.957 + 0.5 * math.cos(math.radians(15))
theta_deg = 15.0
theta_rad = math.radians(theta_deg)
print(f'Pose at frame 84: ({cam_x:.3f}, {cam_y:.3f}, {theta_deg:.1f} deg)')

# Leg color
mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 70) & (img[:, :, 0] < 110) & (img[:, :, 1] > 70) & (img[:, :, 1] < 110) & (img[:, :, 2] > 70) & (img[:, :, 2] < 110)
pts = np.argwhere(mask)
pts_stool = pts[(pts[:, 1] > 230) & (pts[:, 1] < 310) & (pts[:, 0] > 320)]

legs = []
for u_min, u_max in [(235, 260), (265, 285), (285, 305)]:
    sub = pts_stool[(pts_stool[:, 1] >= u_min) & (pts_stool[:, 1] <= u_max)]
    if len(sub) > 0:
        v_bottom = np.max(sub[:, 0])
        u_center = np.mean(sub[sub[:, 0] == v_bottom, 1])
        legs.append((u_center, v_bottom))

print('Legs bottom (u, v):', legs)

leg_coords = []
for u, v in legs:
    Z_c = 1.55 / ((v - 256.0) / 256.0)
    X_c = ((u - 256.0) / 256.0) * Z_c
    wx = cam_x + Z_c * math.sin(theta_rad) + X_c * math.cos(theta_rad)
    wy = cam_y + Z_c * math.cos(theta_rad) - X_c * math.sin(theta_rad)
    leg_coords.append((wx, wy))
    print(f'Leg at u={u:.1f}, v={v}: Z_c={Z_c:.3f}, X_c={X_c:.3f} -> world=({wx:.3f}, {wy:.3f})')

center_x = np.mean([c[0] for c in leg_coords])
center_y = np.mean([c[1] for c in leg_coords])
print(f'Stool center from visible legs: ({center_x:.3f}, {center_y:.3f})')
"
